title: ContentType
description: A content type (proposal 0006, Part B): the contract between the sources that produce one kind of item and the modes that read it. A folder content-types/<name>/ holds content-type.yaml (this file's shape), fields.schema.json (the fields the kind adds to item/v1) and views.sql (only CREATE VIEW v_<name> statements over the base tables). The store builds the views of the types it holds; agents query them.

version.description: The `<kind>/v<N>` that connectors `produces:` and modes `reads:`. A store records it; a store of another version is refused.

kind.description: The item `kind` value of the items this type describes.

deriveVersion.description: Version of derive.py's output. A store that recorded another one recomputes `derived` from the items it holds (no fetch). Required with `derived`.

derived.description: Fields derive.py computes when the store writes an item; derive(item, version) returns exactly these keys. The store keeps them in items.derived (JSON) and the views read them.

tables.description: Child tables: one row per element of a list field of the item, keyed by table name. The store creates the table (item, n and the columns), deletes its rows with the item and, with fullText, keeps an FTS5 table `<name>_fts` in step.

from.description: The item field holding the list (a list of objects).

moveOut.description: Element fields kept in the table only: removed from the item's stored `ext`.

fullText.description: Table columns indexed by the FTS5 table `<name>_fts` (FTS5 only).

from.description: The element field the column is read from (default: the column name).

type.description: TEXT is stored as a string and INTEGER as a whole number; a missing value is '' or 0.

nullable.description: A missing value stays NULL (the value is stored as it is).

views.description: What `describe` tells agents about each view views.sql creates, keyed by view name (v_<name>). The documented columns must equal the real ones.

item.description: One row per item: describe adds samples and a time span.

includes.description: The view starts with every column of this view (v_items or a view of the same type, created earlier in views.sql); `note` is what describe says about those columns.

fullText.description: The view is the full-text view of a child table's FTS5 index: it exists only with FTS5, and describe lists it after the other views.

over.description: The view whose rows it searches (describe reports its row count).

table.description: The child table whose `<table>_fts` it reads.
